verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-definable rules engine or event-triggered automation in sevDesk. The closest items do not count: automatic booking-category suggestions are built-in behavior, not user-defined rules; partner integrations are adjacent features; and the REST API is a developer building block someone could use to construct automation, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
